scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 playable with substantial recurring friction; 7 good with noticeable rough edges; 10 exceptional observed mobile experience. Scores judge observed quality, not win/loss; overall is holistic, not an arithmetic average.

controls.reason: Large separated buttons, tap aim and approach assist enabled useful play. Swipe direction required learning; moving fire and precise flanking were difficult in this paused synthetic session.

gameplay.reason: Recovery objectives and staged coil destruction gave understandable progress and tactical choices. Both fights became dominated by occlusion, incoming fire and finding a firing face; upload and later content unassessed.

presentation.reason: Strong teal/amber visual identity, atmospheric rainy station, consistent menus and clear memory/coil feedback. Walls often dominated the actual portrait view.

usability.reason: Readable handbook, paused planning map with route and receiver selection, assisted approach, distinct fresh/retry actions. Repeated map consultation was necessary for this reviewer.

readability.reason: Health, ammunition and main objectives are legible; upper status percentages, compass, cues and terminal detail text are small at 390x844, while dark geometry and close structures reduce scene comprehension.

cleanup.result: Owned driver 21322 and Chrome 21332 absent; no processes killed

holisticAssessment: Promising and playable portrait shooter with strong atmosphere and useful assistance, but recurring spatial/occlusion and firing-position friction kept the observed mobile experience from feeling consistently fluent. Two losses do not determine the grade. No claim of enjoyment for unassessed content.
